title: Square root of the Viola error
statement: Let $0\leq\varepsilon\leq1$ and let $d$ be a natural number with $1\leq d$. Define $V(\varepsilon,d)=9\varepsilon^{1/2^{d-1}}$. Then $\sqrt{V(\varepsilon,d)}=\frac13 V(\varepsilon,d+1)$.
